description: All your projects, alive at once — for developers juggling coding agents across many projects. Terminals, agents, and layout stay intact when switching. 100% open source, free forever.
rules: Extensions touch the app only through ctx and @silo-code/sdk types — never host internals (state/services/layout/panels/docked/components)
No raw @tauri-apps/* or node:* imports in extension code — route platform access through ctx

Extension CSS may only use design tokens (--silo-color-*, --silo-font*, --silo-radius-*, --silo-button-*) — never a component token (--silo-content-*, --silo-statusbar-*, …) or internal token (--silo-internal-*)
Declare only the silo.permissions (fs:read, fs:write, process, network) an extension actually needs in package.json
Register everything through ctx.subscriptions / return a Disposable so uninstall cleans up fully
Check apps/docs/roadmap.md badge status (stable/experimental/planned) before depending on a ctx API
